description: This skill helps you write 种草社区 / 图文社区 style notes — hook titles within platform limits, a first-person body with emoji and short lines, hashtag sets mixing broad and niche tags, cover copy, and a closing line that invites comments. Trigger phrases include '种草笔记', '种草文案', '图文笔记', '好物文案', '探店文案'. It avoids overclaiming, medical or absolute-effect wording, and platform-prohibited claims.
